svg.title: RAM. Limited connections.
svg.desc: limited-conn: sampled peak memory from the upstream-selected repetition; lower is better. Same overall top 15; rows sorted by memory at 4,096 connections. Solid horizontal bars on a linear scale from zero; independent scale per profile, shared by its connection panels. Original units and precision retained. dusty, 4096 connections: 76MiB; ntex, 4096 connections: 86MiB; actix, 4096 connections: 87MiB; doba, 4096 connections: 100MiB; libuvcpp, 4096 connections: 120MiB; tako, 4096 connections: 162MiB; flare, 4096 connections: 530MiB; fiber, 4096 connections: 904MiB; araara, 4096 connections: 976MiB; bun, 4096 connections: 1.3GiB; spliffy, 4096 connections: 1.8GiB; fulmine.js, 4096 connections: 2.1GiB; vertx, 4096 connections: 2.7GiB; genhttp-ioxide, 4096 connections: 2.8GiB; morojs, 4096 connections: 3.9GiB
